scope: Opt-in failure-metadata adapter; original parsing and process handling remain unchanged.

component_chain.chain: evaluate -> live -> diagnostic invoke -> mocked process -> save/load
component_chain.fixture: Matching model/provider, stopReason=error, synthetic HTTP 429/usage-limit text containing a fake credential and thinking sentinel
component_chain.observed: Original rejection preserved; mismatches=[stopReason], HTTP status and fixed error signal retained; no raw secret or thinking text saved

validation.preservation: Original runner, both pilot freezes, prior judgments and failed attempt unchanged

limitations: Historical lost metadata cannot be reconstructed
The adapter must be explicitly selected by a new authorized controller; frozen historical entrypoints remain unchanged
Nonzero process exit and timeout retain original stderr-withheld behavior; completion metadata is unavailable there
Error signals are bounded pattern matches, not verified root causes
Identifier shape and known credential prefixes are filtered; this is not a general-purpose secret detector
No live failure reproduced and no paid retry performed
